Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde is a hospital located within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] that participates in national clinical quality tracking for cardiovascular care in Denmark [^src4]. It is specifically evaluated in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual report, which monitors treatment quality for atrial fibrillation patients across the country for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. 

The hospital is highlighted for meeting the required clinical standards in detailed hospital-level analyses. Notably, it achieved compliance with [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who undergo an echocardiography [^src2]. During the reporting period, Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde successfully met the national standard by performing this diagnostic procedure on 81.3% (95% CI: 77.8–84.5) of eligible patients [^src2]. 

Beyond Indicator 2, the hospital's performance is tracked across multiple other clinical metrics in the AFDK report. It is evaluated for Indicator 1, where it also met the standard, as well as Indicator 4a, which measures anticoagulation treatment coverage two years after diagnosis [^src1] [^src3] [^src4]. The inclusion of Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde in these detailed regional and national tables underscores its role in the broader Danish healthcare system's ongoing quality improvement efforts [^src3].
